## **📌 IF Quantification (0.1 micromolar)**
```{r box, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)

# Create the dataset
data <- data.frame(
  Group = c("CX5461", "CX5461", "CX5461", "Dox", "Dox", "Dox", "Veh", "Veh", "Veh"),
  Timepoint = rep(c("3hr", "24hr", "48hr"), 3),
  Value = c(0.061466165, 0.067762557, 0.088047269, 0.917955172, 0.966928151, 0.971058146, 0.031829574, 0.049387, 0.051628802),
  SD = c(0.004323308, 0.014429224, 0.001840372, 0.004374925, 0.004902835, 0.007202724, 0.003258145, 0.011219061, 0.016167809)
)

# Ensure the order of groups and timepoints
data$Group <- factor(data$Group, levels = c("Veh", "CX5461", "Dox"))
data$Timepoint <- factor(data$Timepoint, levels = c("3hr", "24hr", "48hr"))

# Create the bar chart with error bars
ggplot(data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Value - SD, ymax = Value + SD), 
                position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.25) +
  labs(title = "Immunofluorescence quantification 0.1 micromolar", 
       x = "Timepoint", 
       y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```
